blocks.original_text: Abstract
blocks.translation: 摘要
blocks.original_extracted_text: Abstract

blocks.original_text: A faster storage device should make serving faster. We find the opposite. High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) stacks NAND behind a wide, package-local interface, promising flash-scale capacity with far lower read latency and higher bandwidth than an SSD. The obvious move is to keep an SSD-style Mooncake KV-offloading stack and swap in HBF underneath. We built that system and measured it: an extended TokenSim, four complete two-hour Qwen-Bailian production traces, five dense and mixture-of-experts models, and H100/B200 profiles. The upgrade backfires. Average end-to-end latency rises 2–5.5× and maximum SLO goodput falls 1.1–2.7× across H100 and B200, so the faster device yields a slower system. A cost-benefit model explains the paradox: a faster far tier pays off only when read I/O is the bottleneck, reads outweigh writes, and delivered bandwidth is sustainable. Transient KV violates all three at once. Buying flash through the package costs GPU near-tier capacity and bandwidth, while HBF’s own read/write latency barely matters: scaling it 3.75× moves latency less than 1%. Worse, the two-tier hierarchy keeps reuse in the near tier and hands HBF a relentless write-heavy stream. Writes outnumber reads on every trace, so a 3D-ICE model shows the stack hits its thermal limit well below peak bandwidth, and a TLC tier wears out sooner than the SSD pool it replaced. The device is fine; the drop-in deployment is not. HBF sucks as an SSD replacement for transient KV, but earns its place in LLM serving when used selectively with reuse-aware placement, write budgeting, and thermal coordination.
blocks.translation: 存储设备更快，推理服务理应也更快。我们发现，结果恰好相反。高带宽闪存（High-Bandwidth Flash，HBF）把 NAND 堆叠在封装内的宽接口之后，有望兼具闪存级容量，以及远低于 SSD 的读取延迟和更高的带宽。最直接的做法，是保留 SSD 式的 Mooncake KV 卸载栈，把底下的介质换成 HBF。我们构建了这样的系统，并通过扩展后的 TokenSim 进行评估：使用四份完整的、各两小时的 Qwen-Bailian 生产轨迹、五个稠密／混合专家模型，以及 H100／B200 配置。结果这次升级适得其反。在 H100 和 B200 上，平均端到端延迟达到基线的 2–5.5 倍，满足 SLO 的最大有效吞吐则降至原来的约 1/1.1–1/2.7；设备更快了，系统却更慢。一个成本收益模型解释了这个矛盾：更快的远端存储层，只有在读取 I/O 是瓶颈、读取足以抵偿写入、实际交付的带宽能够持续时才划算。短暂存活的 KV 同时违反了这三个条件。通过封装换取闪存容量，要牺牲 GPU 近端层的容量和带宽；HBF 自身的读写延迟却几乎不影响结果：将其改变 3.75 倍，端到端延迟的变化仍不足 1%。更糟的是，两级层次把可复用数据留在近端层，却把源源不断的写密集流量交给 HBF。每份轨迹的写入都多于读取，因此 3D-ICE 模型显示，堆栈在远低于峰值带宽时就触及温度上限；TLC 层也比被替换的 SSD 池更早耗尽寿命。问题不在设备本身，而在这种直接替换的部署方式。HBF 作为短暂 KV 的 SSD 替代品表现很糟，但如果配合考虑复用的数据放置、写入预算和温度协调，有选择地使用，它仍能在 LLM 推理服务中发挥作用。

blocks.original_text: Large language model (LLM) inference stores a key and value vector for every retained token. The key–value (KV) cache grows with context length, batch size, and active requests, limiting concurrency and retained context. Paged allocation, quantization, and selective retention reduce waste or bytes per token [8, 15, 18, 28] but not the capacity limit. When the working set of prefixes and histories exceeds GPU memory, the system must place KV in a larger tier.
blocks.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）推理会为每个保留的词元存储一组键向量和值向量。键值（KV）缓存随上下文长度、批大小和活跃请求数增长，从而限制并发量和可保留的上下文。分页分配、量化和选择性保留可以减少浪费或降低每词元的字节数 [8, 15, 18, 28]，但无法消除容量限制。当需要保留的前缀和历史工作集超过 GPU 存储容量时，系统必须把 KV 放到容量更大的层级中。

blocks.original_text: Modern serving systems offload reusable KV to a larger tier. Reuse comes from repeated dialogue, common prefixes in shared prompts and documents, and context revisited by agent workflows. Mooncake and related systems therefore extend the KV pool into CPU DRAM, remote memory, and SSDs [5, 20]. This offloading is standard and essential: without it, a capacity-limited server must reject requests or recompute evicted KV. It supplies the objects that larger tiers store and restore.
blocks.translation: 现代推理服务系统会把可复用的 KV 卸载到更大的存储层。复用来自重复对话、共享提示词和文档中的公共前缀，以及智能体工作流再次访问的上下文。因此，Mooncake 及相关系统把 KV 池扩展到 CPU DRAM、远端内存和 SSD [5, 20]。这种卸载已经是常规且必要的做法：没有它，容量受限的服务器就只能拒绝请求，或者重新计算已经淘汰的 KV。卸载机制也由此产生了需要由更大存储层保存和恢复的数据对象。

blocks.original_text: High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) connects stacked NAND to the accelerator through a wide memory interface. We base our evaluation on the HBF roadmap’s near-term organizations, HBF-1 (2028) and HBF-2 (2030) [11]. HBF-1 pairs package-local HBF with a GDDR7 near tier; HBF-2 shares package sites between HBM and HBF. These dates denote roadmap projections; HBF-3 follows in 2032.

blocks.original_text: HBF studies demonstrate benefits for read-mostly objects and specialized data paths [7, 9]. We take the interface and management requirements directly from the OCP base-die specification: AXI over UCIe, page-oriented writes, and host-directed data layout [1]. We study HBF under an unmodified Mooncake-style SSD KV-pooling runtime: admission, retention, lookup, and KV save and restore remain unchanged while the backing tier and transport change. Faster flash service thus arrives with changes in near-tier capacity and bandwidth. The pooling policy determines which objects reach HBF; admission and queueing determine the serving outcome. Table 1 places this evaluation alongside recent HBF studies with other organizations and workloads.
blocks.translation: 已有 HBF 研究展示了它对以读为主的对象和专用数据路径的收益 [7, 9]。本文直接从 OCP 基础裸片规范中采用接口和管理要求，包括通过 UCIe 传输 AXI、以页为单位的写入，以及由主机指导的数据布局 [1]。我们研究的是未修改的 Mooncake 式 SSD KV 池化运行时：准入、保留、查找、KV 保存和恢复均不变，只改变后备层和传输方式。因此，闪存服务变快的同时，近端层的容量和带宽也发生变化。池化策略决定哪些对象会到达 HBF；准入和排队决定最终的服务表现。表 1 将本文与采用其他组织和工作负载的近期 HBF 研究并列比较。

Table 3 summarizes the evaluation workloads, model profiles, and system organizations.

blocks.original_text: The measured behavior arises from the interaction between the SSD-style hierarchy and the roadmap package tradeoff. The hierarchy sends HBF transient and write-heavy KV, whose traffic exercises the physical limits of NAND. The boundary is simple: faster media helps only when secondary-tier service is on the request critical path (C1), later reads repay each flash write (C2), and delivered bandwidth is sustainable (C3). § 5 formalizes these as three necessary conditions, each with a falsifiable requirement tested by two findings. HBF helps only when all three hold at once, so failing any one sinks the substitution.
blocks.translation: 这种结果来自 SSD 式层次与路线图中的封装取舍共同作用。该层次交给 HBF 的，是短暂存活且写密集的 KV，恰好会触及 NAND 的物理限制。适用边界很简单：只有当次级层服务位于请求关键路径上（C1）、后续读取足以偿还每次闪存写入的成本（C2），并且实际带宽可持续（C3）时，更快介质才有帮助。第 5 节把它们形式化为三个必要条件；每个条件都有一个可证伪要求，并通过两个实验发现检验。HBF 要有收益，三个条件必须同时成立；任何一个失败，都足以让替换方案失去意义。

blocks.original_text: C1—Read I/O is the serving bottleneck. blocks.original_text: The OCP specification defines HBF as a non-coherent, memory-centric device using AXI over UCIe rather than NVMe. The host maps global addresses across independent channels; the base die maps channel-local addresses to NAND and handles ECC, bad blocks, and command scheduling [1, §§3–5]. OCP specifies 64-byte reads, with two page-cache buffers per bank and ordered NAND sensing within each bank. Cache hits can bypass sensing, while batch-read hints control dispatch [1, §5.3].
blocks.translation: OCP 规范将 HBF 定义为非一致性、以内存为中心的设备，采用通过 UCIe 传输的 AXI，而不是 NVMe。主机在独立通道间映射全局地址；基础裸片把通道内地址映射到 NAND，并负责 ECC、坏块和命令调度 [1，第 3–5 节]。OCP 规定以 64 字节为单位读取，每个存储体有两个页缓存缓冲区，且同一存储体中的 NAND 感测有序进行。缓存命中时可以绕过感测，批量读取提示则用于控制请求派发 [1，第 5.3 节]。

blocks.original_text: 2.3.2 Shorter path and a cooperative hierarchy. HBF removes PCIe/NVMe command processing, host staging, and board links. blocks.original_text: The wide interface does not change NAND, so HBF inherits three device-level limits relative to HBM. First, latency: NAND reads and writes take on the order of microseconds, roughly two orders of magnitude longer than HBM accesses; programs are slower and more energy-intensive than reads [9]. Die-, plane-, and channel-level parallelism raises aggregate bandwidth but does not close this per-access gap.

blocks.original_text: Agentic and conversational workloads dominate modern LLM deployments: multi-turn dialogue, tool-use loops, shared system prompts, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). They revisit tokens, reusing prompt prefixes and session histories across requests. Serving therefore depends less on raw compute than on memory capacity to retain useful prefixes and active histories and bandwidth to restore or stream them without stalling the GPU.
blocks.translation: 现代 LLM 部署主要面向智能体和对话负载，包括多轮对话、工具调用循环、共享系统提示词，以及检索增强生成（RAG）。这些负载会再次访问已有词元，在请求之间复用提示前缀和会话历史。因此，服务表现越来越依赖于存储容量能否保留有用前缀和活跃历史，以及带宽能否在不阻塞 GPU 的情况下恢复或流式读取它们，而不仅是原始算力。

blocks.original_text: Unlike static shared weights, KV is generated online, grows during decode, and has request-, session-, and prefix-specific lifetimes. Stored prefixes matter only if later requests reuse them before eviction. Continuous batching adds pressure: admissions consume KV capacity, long requests retain blocks longer, and restoring offloaded state can delay execution. KV placement, reuse, and request scheduling must therefore be optimized together.
blocks.translation: KV 不同于静态共享权重：它在线生成，随解码增长，其寿命取决于请求、会话和前缀。保存前缀只有在之后的请求能于淘汰前复用它时才有意义。连续批处理会进一步增加压力：接纳新请求要消耗 KV 容量，长请求占用块的时间更长，恢复已卸载状态也可能推迟执行。因此，KV 放置、复用和请求调度必须联合优化。

A block table maps each request’s logical KV blocks to non-contiguous physical blocks in GPU memory. blocks.original_text: 3.2.2 Mooncake and distributed KV pools. Paged allocation solves on-GPU layout but not capacity beyond HBM. Mooncake extends KV into a distributed, KV-cache-centric pool of CPU DRAM, SSDs, and network resources. It combines a transfer engine with KV-aware, SLO-aware scheduling that rejects work early under overload [20]. KV-cache-centric scheduling treats KV-block location, availability, reuse, and transfer cost as first-class state beyond request selection.
blocks.translation: 3.2.2 Mooncake 与分布式 KV 池。分页分配解决了 GPU 内部的布局问题，却不能解决超出 HBM 的容量问题。Mooncake 把 KV 扩展成以 KV 缓存为中心的分布式池，涵盖 CPU DRAM、SSD 和网络资源。它将传输引擎与感知 KV、感知 SLO 的调度相结合，在过载时尽早拒绝任务 [20]。这种以 KV 缓存为中心的调度，除了选择请求，还把 KV 块的位置、可用性、复用和传输成本作为需要直接管理的状态。

blocks.original_text: We report TTFT, TBT, end-to-end latency, delivered request and token throughput, queueing and connector delay, KV hits, blocks and bytes read and written, the write/read ratio, prefix reuse, recomputation, and SLO goodput. For the architecture comparison we average each metric over the trace and model campaign at every system and latency point, because the question is how the complete SSD, HBF-1, and HBF-2 organizations behave, not how one favorable point behaves. The write/read ratio and prefix hit rate in Finding 3 come from the per-tier byte counters over a full two-hour replay of each trace, so they reflect fixed request contents and ordering rather than a sampled window. Zero-read runs are excluded from the ratio because it is undefined, and malformed result files are excluded. blocks.original_text: Thermal and endurance models use the serving-trace measurements. For thermal behavior we build a 16-Hi HBF stack similar to HBM4, with 128-layer 3D-NAND TLC dies, and solve its steady-state heat flow with 3D-ICE [23]. We use read and write energy per 16-token KV block, matching the connector’s access granularity, and sweep sustained single-stack bandwidth to obtain dynamic power and peak temperature. We choose 80°C as the model’s safe junction temperature and use a throttling policy that closes the hottest, highest-traffic planes and redirects writes to cooler planes once the limit is reached. The OCP specification defines normal operation, light and severe throttling, and shutdown. Its throttling thresholds are configurable [1, §9].
blocks.translation: 热模型和耐久性模型使用服务轨迹中统计的测量值。热行为方面，我们构建了类似 HBM4 的 16 层裸片堆叠 HBF，每个裸片为 128 层 3D NAND TLC，并用 3D-ICE 求解稳态热流 [23]。读写能量以 16 词元 KV 块为单位，与连接器访问粒度一致；扫描单堆栈持续带宽，得到动态功耗和峰值温度。模型选择 80°C 作为安全结温；到达上限后，关闭最热且流量最高的平面，将写入转向较冷的平面。OCP 规范定义了正常运行、轻度与严重限流，以及关机状态；限流温度阈值可以配置 [1，第 9 节]。

blocks.original_text: Two quantities account for this behavior. The first is coverage. A base-die engine sees only the cold KV the runtime has already placed in HBF, and the mean HBF-resident fraction is just 15.48% (Fig. 8(b)), so even a perfect HBF engine cannot touch the common HBM-resident case. Table 7 tracks residency and leverage across traces. thinking keeps only 4% of attention in HBF and sees essentially no benefit. traceA at 27% residency has the most eligible work, yet it is still net-negative, which brings in the second quantity, scale. The HBF path pays a 12 μs access on every step, and many low-load decode steps are too small to amortize it. The end-to-end numbers follow the same accounting, since MoE compute, expert communication, prefill, HBF transfers, and queueing are unchanged by either engine.

blocks.original_text: Reuse distribution across blocks. The two observations reconcile through the reuse distribution, not the average. Reuse is extremely skewed. The top decile of unique blocks supplies 64% (traceA) to 95–100% (thinking, traceB) of all reuse reads, with Gini 0.80–1.0. Those hot blocks are the ones the near tier keeps resident, so those hits are served from HBM or GDDR, and what reaches HBF is the long cold tail, written once and rarely read again. traceB is the extreme, with only 6% of blocks ever reused, so almost everything it sends HBF is write-once and its ratio is highest. A cache tier that mostly writes is therefore the hierarchy doing its job, not a misconfiguration. It keeps reuse where it is fastest to serve and hands the tier that should hold read-mostly data a write-mostly stream.

blocks.original_text: Under save/restore pooling, $\rho$ depends on both object class and placement. Stable weights and static tensors support many reads per write ($\rho\gg1$), and shared-prefix KV can amortize one write over many requests. Private decode KV grows token by token and dies when the request finishes, leaving few opportunities for a later restore. The traces quantify cross-request reuse: The fraction of blocks ever reused across requests is 46.8%, 6.0%, 39.0%, and 14.3%. The pooling policy determines how much of that reuse reaches the flash tier. This is why H3 and HAVEN place stable, read-mostly objects in HBF [7, 9]. The problem is not that HBF cannot hold KV, but that the SSD-style hierarchy routes the least reusable KV to the device least able to absorb writes.
blocks.translation: 在保存／恢复式池化中，$\rho$ 同时取决于对象类别与放置位置。稳定权重和静态张量可以每写一次读很多次，即 $\rho\gg1$；共享前缀 KV 也可以用多个请求摊薄一次写入。请求私有的解码 KV 则逐词元增长，请求结束就失去用途，很少有后续恢复的机会。轨迹量化了跨请求复用：曾被不同请求复用的块占比分别为 46.8%、6.0%、39.0% 和 14.3%。池化策略决定这些复用中有多少会落到闪存层。这也解释了 H3 和 HAVEN 为什么把稳定、以读为主的对象放到 HBF [7, 9]。问题不是 HBF 不能存 KV，而是 SSD 式层次把最不容易复用的 KV，送给了最不擅长承受写入的设备。

On SSD a write is dominated by high fixed per-operation overhead and a random-access penalty, and usable bandwidth is low relative to demand. blocks.original_text: Why the shortfall is structural. HBF is attached like memory but behaves like flash. OCP assigns ECC, bad-block handling, and write accumulation to the base die. Wear leveling can run in the base die or on the host [1, §§4.4, 5.4, 11.4]. Wear leveling distributes wear but leaves the pooling stream’s programming demand intact. Unlike an SSD’s internal reclamation machinery [4], OCP delegates live-data movement and reclamation to the host. Zone remapping requires invalid data and quiesced reads before rewriting [1, §11.4]. OCP specifies host refresh for data age and read-disturb counts, and 24-hour powered-on retention at 85°C [1, §§9, 11.5]. These responsibilities make write volume, wear distribution, and data lifetime explicit inputs to placement, rather than properties hidden by a peak-bandwidth number. Block granularity does not route around that state. Small blocks maximize the number of write operations. Larger blocks increase bytes written and write amplification: partial reuse can still require rewriting the entire block. Both keep the device on the wrong side of Eq. (8).
blocks.translation: 这种差距为什么具有结构性。HBF 像内存一样连接，却仍像闪存一样工作。OCP 把 ECC、坏块处理和写入积累交给基础裸片。磨损均衡可以在基础裸片或主机上运行 [1，第 4.4、5.4、11.4 节]；它能分散磨损，却不会减少池化流量的编程需求。不同于 SSD 内部的回收机制 [4]，OCP 将有效数据搬移与回收委托给主机。区域重新映射要求先让数据失效，并在重写前使读取静止 [1，第 11.4 节]。OCP 还要求主机根据数据年龄与读干扰计数执行刷新，并规定在 85°C 通电状态下保留数据 24 小时 [1，第 9、11.5 节]。这些职责使写入量、磨损分布和数据寿命成为数据放置必须显式考虑的输入，不能藏在峰值带宽数字背后。调整块粒度也绕不过这些状态：小块使写操作次数最多；大块则增加写入字节和写放大，因为即便只复用部分内容，也可能需要重写整个块。两种情况都让设备处于式（8）不划算的一侧。

blocks.original_extracted_text: Why the shortfall is structural. HBF is attached like memory but behaves like flash. OCP assigns ECC, bad-block handling, and write accumulation to the base die. Wear leveling can run in the base die or on the host [1, §§4.4, 5.4, 11.4]. Wear leveling distributes wear but leaves the pooling stream’s programming demand intact. Unlike an SSD’s internal reclamation machinery [4], OCP delegates live-data movement and reclamation to the host. Zone remapping requires invalid data and quiesced reads before rewriting [1, §11.4]. OCP specifies host refresh for data age and read-disturb counts, and 24-hour powered-on retention at 85 ◦ C [1, §§9, 11.5]. These responsibilities make write volume, wear distribution, and data lifetime explicit inputs to placement, rather than properties hidden by a peak-bandwidth number. Block granularity does not route around that state. Small blocks maximize the number of write operations. Larger blocks increase bytes written and write amplification: partial reuse can still require rewriting the entire block. Both keep the device on the wrong side of Eq. (8).

blocks.original_text: For the HBF roadmap organizations studied here—HBF-1 (2028) and HBF-2 (2030)— replacing an SSD KV tier with HBF does not improve LLM serving; under the same Mooncake-style runtime it makes serving worse. Our model explains why: a faster far tier helps only when read I/O is the serving bottleneck (C1), reads outweigh writes (C2), and its bandwidth is sustainable (C3), and all three fail for transient KV behind an SSD-style connector. HBF sucks as a drop-in SSD KV pool under this unmodified runtime: serving slows down, and the trace-driven endurance comparison shows that HBF wears out sooner than the capacity-matched SSD pool it replaces. The OCP specification defines page-write and layout rules and lifecycle controls. These reinforce the need to change the pooling policy and data path, not merely replace the backing medium.
blocks.translation: 对于本文研究的路线图组织 HBF-1（2028）和 HBF-2（2030），用 HBF 替换 SSD KV 层并不会改善 LLM 推理服务；在相同 Mooncake 式运行时下，反而使服务变差。模型解释了原因：更快的远端层只有在读取 I/O 是服务瓶颈（C1）、读取足以抵偿写入（C2）、带宽可持续（C3）时才有帮助；而 SSD 式连接器背后的短暂 KV 三个条件都不满足。在这个未修改的运行时下，把 HBF 当成可直接替换 SSD 的 KV 池，表现确实很糟：服务变慢，轨迹驱动的耐久性比较还显示，它比被替换的容量匹配 SSD 池更早耗尽寿命。OCP 规范规定了页写入与布局规则，以及生命周期控制。这些要求进一步表明，需要改变池化策略和数据路径，而不只是更换后备介质。

figures.title: 图 1 · HBF-1 与 HBF-2 的封装布局
figures.reading_note: 先看 HBF 占了什么位置。(a) 中介层全部给 HBF，原来的快速层转到板上的 GDDR7；(b) HBM 和 HBF 各占部分中介层位置。本文比较的不只是 SSD 换成更快的闪存，还包括近端层随封装一起改变。2028、2030 是路线图年份，图示不是已量产硬件实测。图内器件标注与表 2、表 3 的配置分别按原文保留，后续容量、带宽比较应查表 3(c)。
figures.original_caption: Figure 1: Modeled layouts based on the KAIST HBF roadmap.
figures.translated_caption: 图 1：依据 KAIST HBF 路线图建立的布局模型。

figures.title: 图 2 · HBF 堆栈内部结构
figures.reading_note: 从下往上看：GPU PCB → 中介层 → 基础裸片 → 多层 NAND 裸片。Power TSVs 是供电硅通孔，Signal TSVs 是信号硅通孔，MC 是存储控制器。右上展开一个 NAND 裸片，展示分布式 TLC 子阵列。这里说明高带宽来自大量并行连接，NAND 本身仍需感测、编程和擦除。
figures.original_caption: Figure 2: Physical organization of an HBF package.
figures.translated_caption: 图 2：HBF 封装的物理组织。

figures.title: 图 3 · SSD KV 卸载的数据路径
figures.reading_note: 上图的数据先经 Host DRAM，CPU 参与主机侧 I/O；下图由 GDS／io_uring 路径让 GPU 与 SSD 直接交换 KV。虚线是控制路径，实线是数据路径；“Control Path Only”不表示 CPU／主机在所有方面消失，而是主机暂存被数据路径绕过。因此，现代 SSD 基线本身已经能减少复制和提交开销。
figures.original_caption: Figure 3: SSD offloading of KV: host-staged path (a) versus GPU-direct path (b).
figures.translated_caption: 图 3：KV 的 SSD 卸载：经主机暂存的路径（a）与 GPU 直接路径（b）。

figures.title: 图 4 · 连接器更快，端到端却更慢
figures.reading_note: 分三步看。(a) 纵轴是 HBF／SSD 延迟比，大于 1 表示 HBF 更慢，TTFT、TBT、E2E 的中位比值分别为 1.39、2.24、2.65。(b) 改变介质延迟时，连接器服务时间敏感得多，而 E2E 只变化约 0.8%，说明被加速的这段时间并不是主要暴露瓶颈。(c) 是一个队列失稳示例，各项都按 HBF／SSD 比值画出；要看清横轴指标，等待时间下降也不等于最终吞吐改善。累计连接器服务时间与单请求平均 E2E 是不同统计量，不能直接相减；正文 GLM 示例见 S096。
figures.original_caption: Figure 4: A faster connector, a slower system: HBF cuts transfer time yet raises end-to-end latency because the smaller near tier destabilizes the queue.
figures.translated_caption: 图 4：更快的连接器，更慢的系统：HBF 缩短了传输时间，但更小的近端层使队列失稳，导致端到端延迟上升。

figures.title: 图 5 · 负载升高时的端到端延迟
figures.reading_note: 每个大组是一种模型，组内为 traceA、traceB、coder、thinking。横轴 QPS 是输入请求率；纵轴是相对于该小图低负载 SSD12 的 E2E 倍数，越低越好。蓝色 SSD12、红色 HBF-1、绿色 HBF-2；8/80 和 30/300 分别是读／写延迟，单位 μs，不是实验运行时长。HBF 曲线更早陡升表示更早进入排队饱和；同代 HBF 的两组时序曲线接近，说明单独降低闪存延迟难以改变整体趋势。不同小图的 1 倍数值不同，不能把它们的纵轴当成同一个绝对延迟。
figures.original_caption: Figure 5: End-to-end latency versus load on B200, normalized within each panel to the low-load SSD12 value (1×), across five models and four traces.
figures.translated_caption: 图 5：B200 上端到端延迟随负载的变化，覆盖五个模型、四份轨迹；每个小图均以本图低负载 SSD12 的数值归一化为 1 倍。

figures.title: 图 6 · 实际词元吞吐量
figures.reading_note: 这是实际完成的词元数／秒，纵轴越高越好；蓝色 SSD12 固定为 1。这里展示的是各小图所标负载（图中为 QPS 32）下的归一化点，不能把某根柱子的下降比例直接替代正文整个实验组的平均统计。H100 多个 HBF 柱子约为基线的三分之一，B200 的影响随模型、轨迹变化；要同时结合表 3 的近端层配置看。吞吐量与满足 SLO 的 goodput 也不是同一指标。
figures.original_caption: Figure 6: Delivered token throughput normalized to SSD12 (1×) for H100 (top) and B200 (bottom), across five models and four traces.
figures.translated_caption: 图 6：在五个模型、四份轨迹上，实际词元吞吐量相对于 SSD12（1 倍）的归一化结果；上排为 H100，下排为 B200。

figures.title: 图 7 · TTFT 与 TBT 分别受什么影响
figures.reading_note: 上排 TTFT 表示请求到首词元的时间，下排 TBT 表示相邻输出词元之间的时间；均越低越好。先在同一个模型、同一轨迹中比较蓝／红／绿曲线，再看负载增大时何时突然上升。TTFT 不明显变化并不代表解码体验不受影响，TBT 可能已明显恶化。每个小图都标出自己的 1 倍绝对值，因此不能跨图直接比较归一化数值。
figures.original_caption: Figure 7: Time-to-first-token (top) and time-between-tokens (bottom) versus load, normalized within each panel to the low-load SSD12 value (1×), for representative traces on five models.
figures.translated_caption: 图 7：五个模型上代表性轨迹的首词元时间（上排）和词元间隔时间（下排）随负载变化；每个小图均以本图低负载 SSD12 的值归一化为 1 倍。

figures.title: 图 8 · 近存储注意力：算子收益如何被覆盖率稀释
figures.reading_note: 左图看算子：HBM-NMP 约有 42.8% 的注意力耗时收益，HBF-NMP 则可能为负，四份轨迹的平均值见表 7。右图混合展示不同量：HBF 覆盖率约 15%，HBM 算子收益约 43%，解码端到端 p50、p99 变化却只有 0.39%、0.82%；它们不是可以直接相加的同类指标。HBF 引擎只加速已放入 HBF 的冷 KV，既没有扩大覆盖率，也没有改变其他计算、通信和排队。右图采用压缩跨度的刻度，读柱高时应以标注数值为准。
figures.original_caption: Figure 8: Base-die NMP operator leverage, HBF coverage, and end-to-end dilution. A–T denote traceA, traceB, coder, and thinking.
figures.translated_caption: 图 8：基础裸片近存储处理（NMP）的算子加速作用、HBF 覆盖率，以及端到端收益的稀释。A–T 分别表示 traceA、traceB、coder 和 thinking。

figures.title: 图 9 · SSD 的批量写入收益为什么没迁移过来
figures.reading_note: 左图纵轴为请求 p50 的降低比例，正值越大越好，负值表示更慢。SSD 在 16／128／512 词元块上分别改善约 21.1%／11.9%／8.9%；HBF 则为 9.2%／0.7%／−1.8%。右图给出原因：每桶约容纳 94／15／4 块。这个结论依赖本文把 HBF 随机、顺序带宽设为相同的服务模型；模型中只剩固定操作延迟可被摊薄，不能泛化为任何 HBF 批处理设计都没有用。
figures.original_caption: Figure 9: Batching gain does not transfer from SSD to HBF. (a) Request-p50 reduction from Mooncake batching on SSD-12 vs. HBF-2 across KV block sizes; SSD gains hold everywhere while HBF fades to negative. (b) HBF-2 bucket occupancy collapses as blocks grow, removing the only latency HBF batching can amortize.
figures.translated_caption: 图 9：批处理收益没有从 SSD 迁移到 HBF。（a）不同 KV 块大小下，Mooncake 批处理使 SSD-12 与 HBF-2 请求 p50 降低的幅度；SSD 始终有收益，HBF 则逐步降到负收益。（b）块变大时，HBF-2 每桶容纳的块数急剧下降，削弱了 HBF 批处理唯一能够摊薄的延迟。

figures.title: 图 10 · 温度怎样限制持续带宽
